summary: Hudbay Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 20, 2026, furnishing a Report of Voting Results from its Annual and Special Meeting held May 19, 2026. The report covers routine matters: election of nine directors (all received >94% support), re-appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditor (81.94% for), and a non-binding advisory say-on-pay vote (96.00% for). No special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is involved. This is a routine reporting of meeting results under Canadian securities law, furnished to the SEC as a foreign private issuer.
